articles.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
articles.snippet: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

articles.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
articles.snippet: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

articles.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
articles.snippet: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.

articles.title: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed’s Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held above $80,000 as South Korean tech stocks recovered from a sell-off and traders lowered their expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.

articles.title: Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to undo $5M settlement
articles.snippet: Judge ruled changes in CFTC enforcement priorities and allegations of misconduct by its enforcement division were insufficient to overturn Gemini’s January 2025 settlement.
